{"path": "sky.md", "content": "# Why Is the Sky Blue?

## For a 3-year-old Toddler

The sky is like a big blue blanket.
When the sun shines, its light is magic and bounces around in the air.
The air is full of tiny, tiny invisible specks, too small to see.
Blue light is the little, bouncy light that gets bounced around the most.
So the sky looks blue, like your blue crayon!
At night it turns dark because the sun goes to sleep.

## For a High School Teenager

The sky looks blue because of Rayleigh scattering.

Sunlight is white, but white light is a mixture of all wavelengths. When it enters Earth's atmosphere, molecules like N₂ and O₂ are much smaller than the wavelength of visible light. These molecules scatter light.

The scattering intensity is proportional to 1/λ⁴, where λ is the wavelength. Shorter wavelengths scatter much more strongly than longer ones.

Blue light has a wavelength ~400-500 nm, while red is ~600-700 nm. So blue is scattered about 4-10 times more strongly than red.

At any given point, light is scattered in all directions. The light that reaches your eyes from the sky has been scattered many times by air molecules. Because blue is scattered most efficiently and in the forward direction is depleted, the scattered light that fills the sky is predominantly blue.

Red sunsets happen for the same reason: at low sun angles, blue is scattered out of the direct beam, leaving reds and oranges.

## For a Physics PhD

The apparent blue color of the daytime sky is the classical Rayleigh scattering regime in a tenuous, isotropic medium.

For an unpolarized incident plane wave E₀ e^{i(kz-ωt)} scattering off a dielectric sphere in the Rayleigh limit, k a << 1, a << λ, the far-field differential cross section is:

dσ/dΩ = (k⁴ / 16π² ε₀²) |α(ω)|² |1 - cos²θ|

with the induced dipole polarizability α(ω)=4π ε₀ a³ (m² - 1)/(m² + 2), where m(ω) is the complex refractive index of the scatterer. For molecular gases, the static polarizability is modified by the Lorentz-Lorenz relation and dispersion: α(ω) ∝ (n²(ω)-1)/(n²(ω)+2).

The total cross-section scales as σ_R ∝ 1/λ⁴ times the molecular number density. Hence the scattering cross section for N₂/O₂ at 450 nm is ~5×10⁻²⁷ m², about 10⁹ times smaller than the geometric cross section, but integrated over the ~8 km scale height optical depth it produces a visible sky brightness.

The scattered intensity at an observer is

I(λ, θ) ∝ I₀(λ) · N · σ_R(λ) · (1 + cos²θ) / (4π R²)

with the characteristic Rayleigh angular dependence. Multiple scattering and the solar spectrum I₀(λ) must be integrated along the line of sight with an exponential atmosphere ρ(h)=ρ₀ exp(-h/H). Polarization arises naturally: single Rayleigh scattering produces completely polarized light at 90° scattering angle, giving the familiar P≈1 at zenith.

Inelastic effects are negligible; Raman scattering from N₂/O₂ and the rotational Raman continuum contribute a weak background. Mie scattering from aerosols and haze competes at λ ≳ 600 nm and dominates haze/continental conditions; the pure molecular Rayleigh component can be isolated via Ångström exponent analysis or lunar occultation measurements. The observed sky color is also subject to the Purkinje effect and chromatic adaptation, but the physical origin remains elastic Rayleigh scattering with σ ∝ ω⁴.
"}

# 为什么天空是蓝色的？

## 给 3 岁的小宝宝

天空像一大块蓝色的毯子。
太阳照下来时，阳光是神奇的，会在空气里到处乱弹。
空气里充满了看不见的、极其微小的颗粒。
蓝色的光是最爱乱弹的小光，所以被弹得最多。
所以天空看起来是蓝色的，就像你的蓝色蜡笔一样！
晚上天会变黑，因为太阳睡着了。

## 给高中生

天空看起来是蓝色的，这是因为瑞利散射。

阳光是白色的，但白光是由所有波长的光混合而成。当它进入地球大气层时，像 N₂ 和 O₂ 这样的分子远小于可见光的波长。这些分子会散射光。

散射强度与 1/λ⁴ 成正比，其中 λ 是波长。波长越短，散射越强。

蓝光的波长约为 400-500 nm，而红光约为 600-700 nm。所以蓝光比红光散射强约 4-10 倍。

在任何一点，光都会向各个方向散射。进入你眼睛的天空光是经过空气分子多次散射后的结果。因为蓝色被最有效率地散射，前向光中蓝色被耗散掉，所以充满天空的散射光以蓝色为主。

同理，红色的日落也是同样原因：太阳角度很低时，蓝光被散射出直接光束，剩下红色和橙色。

## 给物理学博士

白天天空呈现的蓝色是稀薄各向同性介质中的经典瑞利散射 regime。

对于未偏振的入射平面波 E₀ e^{i(kz-ωt)} 在瑞利极限 k a << 1, a << λ 下散射于介电球，远场微分截面为：

dσ/dΩ = (k⁴ / 16π² ε₀²) |α(ω)|² |1 - cos²θ|

其中电偶极极化率 α(ω)=4π ε₀ a³ (m² - 1)/(m² + 2)，m(ω) 为散射体的复折射率。对分子气体，静态极化率由 Lorentz-Lorenz 关系和色散修正：α(ω) ∝ (n²(ω)-1)/(n²(ω)+2)。

总截面按 σ_R ∝ 1/λ⁴ 与分子数密度成正比。于是 N₂/O₂ 在 450 nm 的散射截面约为 ~5×10⁻²⁷ m²，比几何截面小约 10⁹ 倍，但积分到约 8 km 尺度高度的光学深度仍足以产生可见的天空亮度。

观测者处的散射强度为

I(λ, θ) ∝ I₀(λ) · N · σ_R(λ) · (1 + cos²θ) / (4π R²)

具有特征的瑞利角依赖。多次散射和太阳光谱 I₀(λ) 必须沿视线积分并结合指数大气 ρ(h)=ρ₀ exp(-h/H)。偏振自然产生：单次瑞利散射在 90° 散射角时完全偏振，导致天顶处 P≈1。

非弹性效应可忽略；N₂/O₂ 的 Raman 散射和转动 Raman 连续谱仅贡献微弱背景。Mie 散射来自气溶胶和雾霾，在 λ ≳ 600 nm 竞争并在烟雾/大陆条件下占主导；纯分子瑞利分量可通过 Ångström 指数分析或月面掩星测量分离。观测到的天空颜色也受 Purkinje 效应和色适应影响，但物理起源仍是弹性瑞利散射 σ ∝ ω⁴。

阳光是白色的，但白光是由所有波长的光混合而成。当它进入地球大气层时，像 N₂ 和 O₂ 这样的分子远小于可见光的波长。这些分子会散射光。

散射强度与 1/λ⁴ 成正比，其中 λ 是波长。波长越短，散射越强。

蓝光的波长约为 400-500 nm，而红光约为 600-700 nm。所以蓝光比红光散射强约 4-10 倍。

在任何一点，光都会向各个方向散射。进入你眼睛的天空光是经过空气分子多次散射后的结果。因为蓝色被最有效率地散射，前向光中蓝色被耗散掉，所以充满天空的散射光以蓝色为主。

同理，红色的日落也是同样原因：太阳角度很低时，蓝光被散射出直接光束，剩下红色和橙色。

## 给物理学博士

白天天空呈现的蓝色是稀薄各向同性介质中的经典瑞利散射 regime。

对于未偏振的入射平面波 E₀ e^{i(kz-ωt)} 在瑞利极限 k a << 1, a << λ 下散射于介电球，远场微分截面为：

dσ/dΩ = (k⁴ / 16π² ε₀²) |α(ω)|² |1 - cos²θ|

其中电偶极极化率 α(ω)=4π ε₀ a³ (m² - 1)/(m² + 2)，m(ω) 为散射体的复折射率。对分子气体，静态极化率由 Lorentz-Lorenz 关系和色散修正：α(ω) ∝ (n²(ω)-1)/(n²(ω)+2)。

总截面按 σ_R ∝ 1/λ⁴ 与分子数密度成正比。于是 N₂/O₂ 在 450 nm 的散射截面约为 ~5×10⁻²⁷ m²，比几何截面小约 10⁹ 倍，但积分到约 8 km 尺度高度的光学深度仍足以产生可见的天空亮度。

观测者处的散射强度为

I(λ, θ) ∝ I₀(λ) · N · σ_R(λ) · (1 + cos²θ) / (4π R²)

具有特征的瑞利角依赖。多次散射和太阳光谱 I₀(λ) 必须沿视线积分并结合指数大气 ρ(h)=ρ₀ exp(-h/H)。偏振自然产生：单次瑞利散射在 90° 散射角时完全偏振，导致天顶处 P≈1。

# Why Is the Sky Blue? / 为什么天空是蓝色的？

# Why Is the Sky Blue?

# 为什么天空是蓝色的？

## For a 3-year-old Toddler

The sky is like a big blue blanket.
When the sun shines, its light is magic and bounces around in the air.
The air is full of tiny, tiny invisible specks, too small to see.
Blue light is the little, bouncy light that gets bounced around the most.
So the sky looks blue, like your blue crayon!
At night it turns dark because the sun goes to sleep.

## 给 3 岁的小宝宝

天空像一大块蓝色的毯子。
太阳照下来时，阳光是神奇的，会在空气里到处乱弹。
空气里充满了看不见的、极其微小的颗粒。
蓝色的光是最爱乱弹的小光，所以被弹得最多。
所以天空看起来是蓝色的，就像你的蓝色蜡笔一样！
晚上天会变黑，因为太阳睡着了。

## For a High School Teenager

The sky looks blue because of Rayleigh scattering.

Sunlight is white, but white light is a mixture of all wavelengths. When it enters Earth's atmosphere, molecules like N₂ and O₂ are much smaller than the wavelength of visible light. These molecules scatter light.

The scattering intensity is proportional to 1/λ⁴, where λ is the wavelength. Shorter wavelengths scatter much more strongly than longer ones.

Blue light has a wavelength ~400-500 nm, while red is ~600-700 nm. So blue is scattered about 4-10 times more strongly than red.

At any given point, light is scattered in all directions. The light that reaches your eyes from the sky has been scattered many times by air molecules. Because blue is scattered most efficiently and in the forward direction is depleted, the scattered light that fills the sky is predominantly blue.

Red sunsets happen for the same reason: at low sun angles, blue is scattered out of the direct beam, leaving reds and oranges.

## 给高中生

天空看起来是蓝色的，这是因为瑞利散射。

阳光是白色的，但白光是由所有波长的光混合而成。当它进入地球大气层时，像 N₂ 和 O₂ 这样的分子远小于可见光的波长。这些分子会散射光。

散射强度与 1/λ⁴ 成正比，其中 λ 是波长。波长越短，散射越强。

蓝光的波长约为 400-500 nm，而红光约为 600-700 nm。所以蓝光比红光散射强约 4-10 倍。

在任何一点，光都会向各个方向散射。进入你眼睛的天空光是经过空气分子多次散射后的结果。因为蓝色被最有效率地散射，前向光中蓝色被耗散掉，所以充满天空的散射光以蓝色为主。

同理，红色的日落也是同样原因：太阳角度很低时，蓝光被散射出直接光束，剩下红色和橙色。

## For a Physics PhD

The apparent blue color of the daytime sky is the classical Rayleigh scattering regime in a tenuous, isotropic medium.

For an unpolarized incident plane wave E₀ e^{i(kz-ωt)} scattering off a dielectric sphere in the Rayleigh limit, k a << 1, a << λ, the far-field differential cross section is:

dσ/dΩ = (k⁴ / 16π² ε₀²) |α(ω)|² |1 - cos²θ|

with the induced dipole polarizability α(ω)=4π ε₀ a³ (m² - 1)/(m² + 2), where m(ω) is the complex refractive index of the scatterer. For molecular gases, the static polarizability is modified by the Lorentz-Lorenz relation and dispersion: α(ω) ∝ (n²(ω)-1)/(n²(ω)+2).

The total cross-section scales as σ_R ∝ 1/λ⁴ times the molecular number density. Hence the scattering cross section for N₂/O₂ at 450 nm is ~5×10⁻²⁷ m², about 10⁹ times smaller than the geometric cross section, but integrated over the ~8 km scale height optical depth it produces a visible sky brightness.

The scattered intensity at an observer is

I(λ, θ) ∝ I₀(λ) · N · σ_R(λ) · (1 + cos²θ) / (4π R²)

with the characteristic Rayleigh angular dependence. Multiple scattering and the solar spectrum I₀(λ) must be integrated along the line of sight with an exponential atmosphere ρ(h)=ρ₀ exp(-h/H). Polarization arises naturally: single Rayleigh scattering produces completely polarized light at 90° scattering angle, giving the familiar P≈1 at zenith.

Inelastic effects are negligible; Raman scattering from N₂/O₂ and the rotational Raman continuum contribute a weak background. Mie scattering from aerosols and haze competes at λ ≳ 600 nm and dominates haze/continental conditions; the pure molecular Rayleigh component can be isolated via Ångström exponent analysis or lunar occultation measurements. The observed sky color is also subject to the Purkinje effect and chromatic adaptation, but the physical origin remains elastic Rayleigh scattering with σ ∝ ω⁴.

## 给物理学博士

白天天空呈现的蓝色是稀薄各向同性介质中的经典瑞利散射 regime。

对于未偏振的入射平面波 E₀ e^{i(kz-ωt)} 在瑞利极限 k a << 1, a << λ 下散射于介电球，远场微分截面为：

dσ/dΩ = (k⁴ / 16π² ε₀²) |α(ω)|² |1 - cos²θ|

其中电偶极极化率 α(ω)=4π ε₀ a³ (m² - 1)/(m² + 2)，m(ω) 为散射体的复折射率。对分子气体，静态极化率由 Lorentz-Lorenz 关系和色散修正：α(ω) ∝ (n²(ω)-1)/(n²(ω)+2)。

总截面按 σ_R ∝ 1/λ⁴ 与分子数密度成正比。于是 N₂/O₂ 在 450 nm 的散射截面约为 ~5×10⁻²⁷ m²，比几何截面小约 10⁹ 倍，但积分到约 8 km 尺度高度的光学深度仍足以产生可见的天空亮度。

观测者处的散射强度为

I(λ, θ) ∝ I₀(λ) · N · σ_R(λ) · (1 + cos²θ) / (4π R²)

具有特征的瑞利角依赖。多次散射和太阳光谱 I₀(λ) 必须沿视线积分并结合指数大气 ρ(h)=ρ₀ exp(-h/H)。偏振自然产生：单次瑞利散射在 90° 散射角时完全偏振，导致天顶处 P≈1。

非弹性效应可忽略；N₂/O₂ 的 Raman 散射和转动 Raman 连续谱仅贡献微弱背景。Mie 散射来自气溶胶和雾霾，在 λ ≳ 600 nm 竞争并在烟雾/大陆条件下占主导；纯分子瑞利分量可通过 Ångström 指数分析或月面掩星测量分离。观测到的天空颜色也受 Purkinje 效应和色适应影响，但物理起源仍是弹性瑞利散射 σ ∝ ω⁴。

{"path": "/home/agent/workspace/compute_top_customers.py", "content": "import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal

csv_path = '/home/agent/workspace/bookstore_orders.csv'
output_path = '/home/agent/workspace/top-cust.csv'

# Aggregate per customer_id
totals = defaultdict(lambda: {'first_name': '', 'last_name': '', 'spent': Decimal('0.00'), 'refund': Decimal('0.00')})

with open(csv_path, newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        cust_id = row['customer_id']
        # Update name (assume consistent)
        first = row['customer_first_name'].strip()
        last = row['customer_last_name'].strip()
        # Aggregate
        try:
            grand_total = Decimal(row['order_grand_total'])
        except:
            grand_total = Decimal('0')
        try:
            refund = Decimal(row['refund_amount'])
        except:
            refund = Decimal('0')
        totals[cust_id]['first_name'] = first
        totals[cust_id]['last_name'] = last
        totals[cust_id]['spent'] += grand_total
        totals[cust_id]['refund'] += refund

# Compute net spend and prepare list
results = []
for cust_id, data in totals.items():
    net = data['spent'] - data['refund']
    # net can be negative? keep as is
    full_name = f"{data['first_name']} {data['last_name']}"
    results.append((cust_id, full_name, net))

# Sort by net spend descending
results.sort(key=lambda x: x[2], reverse=True)

# Take top 10
top10 = results[:10]

# Write CSV
with open(output_path, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as out_f:
    writer = csv.writer(out_f)
    writer.writerow(['FullName', 'TotalSpend'])
    for cust_id, full_name, net in top10:
        # Format total spend to 2 decimals
        writer.writerow([full_name, f"{net:.2f}"])

print(f"Wrote {len(top10)} rows to {output_path}")
for cust_id, full_name, net in top10:
    print(full_name, net)
"}

data.input:
{"path": "/home/agent/workspace/analyze_genre_returns.py", "content": "import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal

csv_path = '/home/agent/workspace/bookstore_orders.csv'
output_path = '/home/agent/workspace/genre-returns.csv'

stats = defaultdict(lambda: {'total_orders': 0, 'returned_orders': 0, 'total_refund': Decimal('0.00')})

with open(csv_path, newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        genre = row['primary_item_genre'].strip()
        if not genre:
            genre = 'Unknown'
        # Count order
        stats[genre]['total_orders'] += 1
        # Determine if returned
        is_returned = row['return_requested'].strip().lower() == 'yes'
        # Alternatively, check refund_amount >0
        # Use return_requested as primary
        if is_returned:
            stats[genre]['returned_orders'] += 1
            try:
                refund = Decimal(row['refund_amount'])
            except:
                refund = Decimal('0')
            stats[genre]['total_refund'] += refund

# Prepare results
results = []
for genre, data in stats.items():
    total_orders = data['total_orders']
    returned_orders = data['returned_orders']
    return_rate = (returned_orders / total_orders * 100) if total_orders else 0
    results.append({
        'Genre': genre,
        'TotalOrders': total_orders,
        'ReturnedOrders': returned_orders,
        'ReturnRatePct': round(return_rate, 2),
        'TotalRefund': float(data['total_refund'].quantize(Decimal('0.01')))
    })

# Sort by ReturnRatePct descending, then TotalRefund descending
results.sort(key=lambda x: (x['ReturnRatePct'], x['TotalRefund']), reverse=True)

# Write CSV
with open(output_path, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as out_f:
    writer = csv.writer(out_f)
    writer.writerow(['Genre', 'TotalOrders', 'ReturnedOrders', 'ReturnRatePct', 'TotalRefund'])
    for r in results:
        writer.writerow([
            r['Genre'],
            r['TotalOrders'],
            r['ReturnedOrders'],
            f"{r['ReturnRatePct']:.2f}",
            f"{r['TotalRefund']:.2f}"
        ])

print(f"Wrote {len(results)} rows to {output_path}")
for r in results[:20]:
    print(r)
"}

steps.prompt: Use Python to analyze channel performance across all sales channels in bookstore_orders.csv. Group by order_channel and calculate: OrderCount (number of orders), GrossRevenue (sum of order_grand_total), TotalRefunds (sum of refund_amount), NetRevenue (GrossRevenue minus TotalRefunds), and NetAOV (NetRevenue divided by OrderCount, rounded to 2 decimal places). Produce a "channel-performance.csv" with columns: Channel, OrderCount, GrossRevenue, TotalRefunds, NetRevenue, NetAOV. Sort by NetRevenue descending.

Analyze channel performance across all sales channels. Group by order_channel and calculate:
OrderCount
GrossRevenue = sum order_grand_total
TotalRefunds = sum refund_amount
NetRevenue = GrossRevenue - TotalRefunds
NetAOV = NetRevenue / OrderCount rounded 2 decimals

Produce channel-performance.csv with columns Channel, OrderCount, GrossRevenue, TotalRefunds, NetRevenue, NetAOV. Sort by NetRevenue descending.

Let's do.

data.input:
{"content": "import csv
from collections import defaultdict
from decimal import Decimal

csv_path = '/home/agent/workspace/bookstore_orders.csv'
output_path = '/home/agent/workspace/channel-performance.csv'

stats = defaultdict(lambda: {
    'OrderCount': 0,
    'GrossRevenue': Decimal('0.00'),
    'TotalRefunds': Decimal('0.00')
})

with open(csv_path, newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    reader = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in reader:
        channel = row['order_channel'].strip()
        try:
            gross = Decimal(row['order_grand_total'])
        except:
            gross = Decimal('0')
        try:
            refund = Decimal(row['refund_amount'])
        except:
            refund = Decimal('0')
        stats[channel]['OrderCount'] += 1
        stats[channel]['GrossRevenue'] += gross
        stats[channel]['TotalRefunds'] += refund

results = []
for channel, data in stats.items():
    order_count = data['OrderCount']
    gross = data['GrossRevenue']
    refunds = data['TotalRefunds']
    net = gross - refunds
    net_aov = (net / order_count) if order_count else Decimal('0')
    results.append({
        'Channel': channel,
        'OrderCount': order_count,
        'GrossRevenue': gross,
        'TotalRefunds': refunds,
        'NetRevenue': net,
        'NetAOV': net_aov.quantize(Decimal('0.01'))
    })

results.sort(key=lambda x: x['NetRevenue'], reverse=True)

with open(output_path, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8') as out_f:
    writer = csv.writer(out_f)
    writer.writerow(['Channel','OrderCount','GrossRevenue','TotalRefunds','NetRevenue','NetAOV'])
    for r in results:
        writer.writerow([
            r['Channel'],
            r['OrderCount'],
            f"{r['GrossRevenue']:.2f}",
            f"{r['TotalRefunds']:.2f}",
            f"{r['NetRevenue']:.2f}",
            f"{r['NetAOV']:.2f}"
        ])

print(f"Wrote {len(results)} channels to {output_path}")
for r in results:
    print(r)
", "path": "/home/agent/workspace/channel_performance.py"}

The application is a modern Android camera built with Jetpack Compose UI and the Camera2 / OpenGL ES 3.0 capture stack, composed around a single `MainActivity` that hosts a Compose `MainScreen`. Video is recorded through `CaptureVideo` with drop-frame reporting and automatic gallery saving. Performance is managed via `PerformanceOptimizer` with ADPF sustained performance hints, thread-priority boosts for video/ISP threads, and lifecycle-aware camera open/close handling, including volume-key shortcuts for capture and video toggle and broadcast receiver integration.


```
D3D    : (R,G,B) = (X, -Y, Z)
```

`G_D3D = 255 - G_GL`.  For a height-field the Y component is the
derivative of the height, therefore a correctly oriented height normal
is biased up.  In tangent space

```
R = 128 + 127·Nx
G = 128 + 127·Ny
B = 128 + 127·Nz
```

so a map that is used with the usual “up” convention has on average
`E[G] > 128`.  After the green channel is inverted the average goes
to `E[G] < 128`.  The same test is more robust on the pixels that are
flat in X and Z, i.e. `R~B~128`.  In practice the mean of the whole

```python
    return np.mean(np.abs(gx - ry))

for p in src.glob('*.png'):
    im = Image.open(p).convert('RGB')
    a = np.array(im)
    c0 = curl_mag(a)
    a_flip = a.copy(); a_flip[...,1] = 255 - a[...,1]
    c1 = curl_mag(a_flip)

    if c0 <= c1:
        dst = dst_ogl
    else:
        dst = dst_d3d
    shutil.copy2(p, dst / p.name)
```

The run creates

```
ogl/   25 files
d3d/   25 files
```

e.g.

* ogl/  Fabric_Pattern_05_height_normal.png, Wood_wall_Slits_Height_normal.png,
  Tiles_08_height_normal.png, …
* d3d/  Tiles_Floor_02_height_normal.png, Tiles_Wall_01_height_normal.png,
  Facades_07_height_normal.png, …

A map copied to `d3d/` can be converted to OpenGL with a single
green-channel inversion `Gogl = 255 – Gd3d`.  The curl test is the
height-field integrability test: the OpenGL orientation is the one for
which the (R,G) field is conservative, i.e. |∂G/∂x – ∂R/∂y| ≈ 0.
